decisions.occupancy_pattern: no more than one overnight guest per night
decisions.overnight_guest_rule: guests must be checked in with Imani at least 24 hours in advance

commitments.detail: The tenant agrees to pay $500 per month for the room-share.
The tenant agrees to follow the occupancy pattern of no more than one overnight guest per night.
The tenant agrees to maintain quiet hours from 10 PM to 8 AM.
The tenant agrees to check in guests with me at least 24 hours in advance.
